author: willai3213
title: Exhibition graphic design / character visual collaboration
content: Looking for a graphic designer for a December exhibition at Huashan, Taipei. Scope includes main visual, logotype, 6 character visuals (not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition materials. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Seeking hand-drawn, Japanese, warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.
